name: Pip Skein
seed: Trades with Lark, Corvin and Vessa separately. Buys some stolen goods while pretending to be neutral; can earn trust only through restitution.
design: Raccoon, soft gray fur, black eye mask, russet layered waistcoat, turquoise bead and many small labeled pockets.
history: Latchford market child who learned to mediate trades and gradually crossed into fencing stolen freight.
desire: To be welcome in every market without answering for where goods came from.
contradiction: Neutrality is a story they tell when choosing the profitable side.
relationships: Lark buys information; Corvin pays commissions; Vessa brings sightings; Pell remembers their honest first stall.
arc: Returns a valuable stolen item and names its source, losing criminal customers before rebuilding lawful trade.
story_engine: An object has two convincing owners; a bargain turns out to be a family memory somebody should never have sold.
writer_truth: They know some goods are stolen. Cheerfulness is not innocence.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
